notes:
FieldStitch 1.5.4 - more work on the NVIDIA graphics card:
- Rendering: a GPU worker now warps and blends photos on the card alongside the CPU workers. Its first block is rendered on both and compared before the card is trusted; any problem falls back to the CPU.
- Feature detection on the card restructured to do each photo in a few large steps instead of thousands of small ones, and the processes feeding the card get priority so they aren't starved when the CPU is busy.
- The log now records a short GPU benchmark at the start, how busy the card was during features and rendering, and why Windows refused the background-throttling setting if it does.
